n: AAAI K-2 co-designed unplugged AI activities
t: A conference paper on screen-free K-2 AI activities that teachers co-designed around literacy.
steps: Find the paper Co-Designing Unplugged Learning Activities with K-2 Teachers on the AAAI open access server.
Choose one activity that fits a current story or lesson.
Gather simple materials such as picture cards or sorting items.
Plan how students will move or sort during the activity.
Try the activity with a small group first.
Note what worked and adjust before using it with the whole class.
